cases.title: Слайдер под параметром
cases.proof: The contextual slider hides immediately during direct numeric input and returns only when the interaction requires it.

cases.title: Обычный слайдер
cases.proof: Always-visible range and exact field edit one value with the same theme accent as the contextual variant.

cases.title: Шаг, пределы и удержание
cases.proof: Step buttons and keyboard obey bounds; pointer hold repeats and release stops without a duplicate click.

cases.title: Разные значения
cases.proof: The range has no invented mixed position. Entering a number explicitly supplies a value.

cases.title: Ошибка ввода и восстановление
cases.proof: Invalid text remains available for correction and cannot replace the accepted value.

cases.title: Недоступное значение
cases.proof: The accepted numeric value stays visible while both controls reject interaction.

cases.title: Точность и единицы
cases.proof: The exact field, range and exposed value remain consistent at the declared precision.

cases.title: Ввод шире диапазона слайдера
cases.proof: Typing and scrubbing have separate bounds. Range focus alone preserves the accepted out-of-range value.

cases.title: Слайдер с числом только для чтения
cases.proof: A range-only setting does not acquire a new direct-edit contract.
